note: Each case lists the space ids a knowledgeable person would accept as the TOP route for that student. An empty list means the right answer is no route at all. The accepted sets are the coder's judgment from the space documents; Jithin should correct them from what he knows of the spaces. Remember that code sorts routes that are open to the student ahead of ask-first ones, so the top route depends on the audience. Nov 15: the Ahmanson Lab now lists equipment from its own equipment page (a 3D printer, Arduino and Raspberry Pi kits, cameras, microphones) and is open to all four audiences, so it was added to the accepted set of three cases; see each case's why. Later on Nov 15: four spaces were added (ITS printing, Iovine and Young Hall, the Roski shops, the Dramatic Arts scene shop), the Maker Space is now open to Viterbi undergraduates, its 3D prints are staff-made with no training, and its laser cutter needs Level 5. The accepted sets below were written before those changes and have NOT been revised for them. Review every case before running the eval.
